name: Agent Relay

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

free.conditions: Agent Relay Cloud can be explored without a credit card, but no duration, usage allowance or post-free tariff is published.

caveats: Public open-source agent communication/runtime platform and cloud factory. /pricing 404; no verified per-sandbox tariff. Self-hosting does not include host compute. Do not use decorative CLI examples in 404 page as evidence.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

The official SDK documentation explicitly says the core SDK has no managed spawning, browser automation, cloud setup, workflow engine or proactive runtime dependencies; node providers execute on attached machines. Do not infer free compute from Cloud messaging access.

harness_api.quote: `node tail` streams broker events or one agent's output stream. `attach` reconnects to a running agent without spawning a new one (default mode `view`).
harness_api.note: Core product. CLI/SDK spawn a harness with a task (`agent-relay node agent spawn codex --name reviewer --channels reviews --task "Review the docs."`), deliver follow-up messages into live sessions, stream events (addListener/webhooks), attach/release. Prebuilt harnesses (harnesses.md): "`@agent-relay/harnesses` provides prebuilt definitions including `claude`, `codex`, `gemini`, `opencode`,"; fleet-verified: codex, claude, cursor-agent, grok, gemini, droid. The harness runs on YOUR machine (node) or in Cloud flow runs, not in a provider-hosted sandbox you rent separately.

secret_proxy.quote: JWT-authenticated credential proxy for upstream LLM providers.
secret_proxy.note: Open-source first-party proxy: holds OpenAI/Anthropic/OpenRouter keys, sandboxed agents get per-session JWTs plus base-URL overrides and per-credential token budgets. Agent Relay Cloud uses an internal 'house-key proxy' for included Flows runs (signup/agent/flows: "copy a house key into the agent environment or expose it in this guide." (preceded by "Never")). Arbitrary HTTP/DB/SSH/git credential injection not documented; GitHub access goes through the workspace's connected GitHub App (relayfile/relayauth scoped tokens), not a generic proxy.

soc2.quote: We use technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect the information processed by Agent Relay. No system is perfectly secure, so you should connect only the repositories, workspaces, and integrations needed for your work.
soc2.note: No security/trust/compliance page exists (agentrelay.com/security and /trust both 404) and no SOC 2 attestation is mentioned anywhere in docs, privacy policy, or terms.

hipaa.quote: Agent Relay is infrastructure for agents that communicate and coordinate work. This policy explains what information we collect through agentrelay.com, the open-source Agent Relay tools, and hosted Agent Relay Cloud services.
hipaa.note: No HIPAA/BAA mention anywhere on the site; privacy policy does not reference healthcare data handling or a Business Associate Agreement.

sso.quote: Agent Relay uses bearer tokens with distinct prefixes because each token represents a different caller shape. ... Workspace key ... Agent token ... Node token ... Observer token
sso.note: Account/workspace access is via Google OAuth device-code sign-in (per the Flows signup guide) and bearer API tokens; no SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO is documented anywhere.

eu_data_residency.quote: Agent Relay is operated from the United States and may process information in the United States or other countries where our providers operate. By using the service, you understand that information may be transferred outside your country of residence.
eu_data_residency.note: Privacy policy describes only US-based operation with data possibly transferred outside the user's country; no EU region or residency option is offered.

max_session_h.quote: The local broker is optional: use it when this machine should run managed CLI agents or attach to PTY/headless sessions.
max_session_h.note: Agent Relay does not run or bill sandboxes itself, so it imposes no session duration cap; an agent session persists as long as its PTY/process on the enrolled node runs (until released or the node is stopped). No provider-enforced time limit is documented.

usage_api.quote: Agent Relay is the messaging layer for AI agents: channels, DMs, durable delivery, event listeners, and typed actions for any agent runtime. Self-hosted engine... or customer-supplied nodes. Not a compute provider.
usage_api.note: granularity: none; cost: no; Agent Relay does not provision, rent, or bill sandboxes/VMs. It is a message broker and coordination platform where agents run on customer-enrolled machines (nodes). /pricing returns 404; no per-sandbox tariff exists because Relay does not operate machines. The card explicitly notes '/pricing 404; no verified per-sandbox tariff' and 'Core Agent Relay owns messaging, delivery contracts, actions, and events — not spawning.' Therefore, there is no usage API for billable sandbox resources.
